I’m the{NEWLINE}Pokéathlon MC. Nice to meet you!{SCROLL}If there’s anything you don’t get about{NEWLINE}the Pokéathlon, I’ll tell you all about{CLEAR}it from start to finish!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那我就口袋竞技的事情说明一下！{SCROLL}所谓口袋竞技,{NEWLINE}就是精灵和人类的友情！{SCROLL}⋯⋯嗯？{NEWLINE}很难懂？{CLEAR}嗯,详细来说就是{SCROLL}３只精灵组成一队,{CLEAR}进行１０个种类的比赛竞争！{SCROLL}跨越各种各样的障碍！{NEWLINE}从中考验精灵和人类的{CLEAR}友情！{SCROLL}对了,{NEWLINE}这个就代表了友情本身！{SCROLL}明白了吗？{NEWLINE}那么,还有什么吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Let me explain the Pokéathlon!{SCROLL}The Pokéathlon is the friendship{NEWLINE}between Pokémon and people!{SCROLL}...Hm? Hard to understand? Well, in{NEWLINE}more detail...{SCROLL}Three Pokémon form a team and compete{NEWLINE}in ten kinds of events!{SCROLL}They overcome all kinds of obstacles,{NEWLINE}and that tests the friendship between{CLEAR}Pokémon and people!{SCROLL}That’s right, this is friendship itself!{SCROLL}Do you understand what I mean? OK, do{NEWLINE}you have any more questions?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0139/5 | RV039: meaning: US reordered and added I won't be as brief; dropped closing question

strings.zh: 那么我就来说明一下「跨栏」！{SCROLL}冲刺跨栏跑就是比赛速度的比赛,{SCROLL}当靠近栏架时让精灵跳起来,{SCROLL}只要时机对了,就能越过栏架。{SCROLL}以３只的合计时间来计分,{SCROLL}像哥哥一样,{NEWLINE}这是敏捷型的精灵擅长的比赛！{SCROLL}明白了吗？{NEWLINE}那么,还有什么吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ll explain “Hurdle Dash” for you.{NEWLINE}It is an event to test your speed.{SCROLL}Your Pokémon needs to jump{NEWLINE}when the Hurdle comes near.{SCROLL}If it jumps at the right time,{NEWLINE}it will go over the Hurdle!{SCROLL}The total time of the three Pokémon{NEWLINE}gives you the event score.{SCROLL}This is an event for speedy Pokémon{NEWLINE}that move quickly like me!{SCROLL}Do you understand what I mean?{SCROLL}OK, do you have any more questions?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那么我就来说明一下「抢旗」！{SCROLL}抢旗就是把被放置在海滨沙滩的{CLEAR}小旗拿回来,以拿回来的数量{CLEAR}定输赢的比赛。{SCROLL}小旗不是拿到就行,{SCROLL}要带回来才能得分！{SCROLL}是适合像哥哥这样{NEWLINE}速度快技术好的{CLEAR}精灵才拿手的比赛！{SCROLL}明白了吗？{NEWLINE}那么,还有什么吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ll explain “Pennant Capture”{NEWLINE}for you.{SCROLL}Your Pokémon grab Pennants on{NEWLINE}the beach.{SCROLL}Grabbing Pennants doesn’t add to{NEWLINE}your score.{SCROLL}You have to come back with{NEWLINE}the Pennants.{SCROLL}This is an event for speedy and skillful{NEWLINE}Pokémon that move like I do!{SCROLL}Do you understand what I mean?{SCROLL}OK, do you have any more questions?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那么我就来说明一下「抢位置」！{SCROLL}抢位置就是跟对手相互推挤的比赛,{SCROLL}只要在圆环里面就能得分。{SCROLL}这个比赛是以３只的合计点{CLEAR}计算得分！{SCROLL}像哥哥这样力量强大的顽强的精灵{CLEAR}所拿手的比赛！{SCROLL}明白了吗？{NEWLINE}那么,还有什么吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ll explain “Circle Push” for you!{SCROLL}In Circle Push, your Pokémon push{NEWLINE}against your opponents’ Pokémon.{SCROLL}You get points as long as your Pokémon{NEWLINE}stay inside a Circle.{SCROLL}Your score is the three Pokémon’s{NEWLINE}combined points!{SCROLL}This is an event for powerful Pokémon{NEWLINE}with stamina that are strong like me!{SCROLL}Do you understand? OK, do you have any{NEWLINE}more questions?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那么我就来说明一下「劈石板」！{SCROLL}正如其名是把石板破坏掉的比赛,{SCROLL}以破坏掉的石板的个数来计分,{CLEAR}非常容易明白吧。{SCROLL}是像哥哥这样力量强大的精灵{CLEAR}所擅长的比赛！{SCROLL}明白了吗？{NEWLINE}那么,还有什么吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ll explain “Block Smash” for you.{NEWLINE}You smash Blocks as the name suggests.{SCROLL}The number of Blocks you smash{NEWLINE}will be the score you’ll get.{SCROLL}It’s so simple, isn’t it?{SCROLL}This is an event for powerful Pokémon{NEWLINE}that are strong like me!{SCROLL}Do you understand what I mean?{SCROLL}OK, do you have any more questions?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那么我就来说明一下「抢飞碟」！{SCROLL}抢飞碟是用跳的方式接住{CLEAR}飞过来的飞碟的比赛,{SCROLL}飞碟是越在后面接点数越高,{SCROLL}以那点数的合计来计分。{SCROLL}是像哥哥这样强弹跳力和有力量的{CLEAR}精灵擅长的比赛！{SCROLL}明白了吗？{NEWLINE}那么,还有什么吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ll explain “Disc Catch” for you.{NEWLINE}Your Pokémon jump and catch{CLEAR}Discs that come flying toward them.{SCROLL}The longer you wait before they catch{NEWLINE}the Discs, the more points you get.{CLEAR}The total points will decide the score.{SCROLL}This is an event for powerful and jumpy{NEWLINE}Pokémon that move like me!{SCROLL}Do you understand what I mean?{NEWLINE}OK, do you have any other questions?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那么我就来说明一下「蹦床」！{SCROLL}蹦床,顾名思义{NEWLINE}就是在蹦床上蹦了,{CLEAR}然后尽量去碰那些亮着的灯！{SCROLL}碰到灯点数就会增加,{CLEAR}以点数计分。{SCROLL}是像哥哥这样弹跳力比较好的精灵{CLEAR}所擅长的比赛！{SCROLL}明白了吗？{NEWLINE}那么,还有什么吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ll explain “Lamp Jump” for you.{NEWLINE}Your Pokémon bounce to jump high{CLEAR}and touch as many Lamps as they can.{SCROLL}The more Lamps they touch, the more{NEWLINE}points you get.{SCROLL}The total points will decide the score.{SCROLL}This is an event for jumpy Pokémon{NEWLINE}that are jumpy like me!{SCROLL}Do you understand what I mean?{SCROLL}OK, do you have any more questions?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那么我就来说明一下「赛跑」！{SCROLL}赛跑就是把３只精灵交替{SCROLL}在９０秒内到底能跑多远{CLEAR}的竞技比赛,{SCROLL}以跑的距离来计分。{SCROLL}是像哥哥这样顽强有速度的精灵{CLEAR}所擅长的比赛！{SCROLL}明白了吗？{NEWLINE}那么,还有什么吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ll explain “Relay Run” for you.{NEWLINE}Your three Pokémon run in turns as far{CLEAR}as they can in 90 seconds.{SCROLL}The distance of the Relay will decide{NEWLINE}the score.{SCROLL}This is an event for speedy Pokémon{NEWLINE}with stamina... Ones just like me!{SCROLL}Do you understand what I mean?{SCROLL}OK, do you have any more questions?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那么我就来说明一下「撞人」！{SCROLL}让对手的精灵从环落下的比赛,{SCROLL}阻挡成功就得1点{NEWLINE}用跳的方式把对方{CLEAR}压制住就得２点,{SCROLL}若让对方落下的话{NEWLINE}就能得到１０点。{SCROLL}是像哥哥这样顽强的精灵{CLEAR}所擅长的比赛！{SCROLL}明白了吗？{NEWLINE}那么,还有什吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ll explain “Ring Drop” for you.{NEWLINE}Your Pokémon try to knock other{CLEAR}Pokémon out of the Ring.{SCROLL}A tackle gives you one point.{NEWLINE}A stomp on another Pokémon{CLEAR}gives you two points.{SCROLL}If your Pokémon knock another Pokémon{NEWLINE}off the Ring, making them drop, you get{CLEAR}ten points.{SCROLL}This is an event for Pokémon with{NEWLINE}stamina just like I have!{SCROLL}Do you understand what I mean?{NEWLINE}OK, do you have any more questions?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那么我就来说明一下「扔雪球」！{SCROLL}扔雪球就是说可能你不明白⋯⋯{CLEAR}哎,就照字面意思理解了！{SCROLL}以击中对方的雪球的数量计分！{SCROLL}是像哥哥这样力量强大又有技术{CLEAR}的精灵所擅长的比赛！{SCROLL}明白了吗？{NEWLINE}那么,还有什么吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ll explain “Snow Throw” for you.{SCROLL}Snow Throw is... well, you might not get{NEWLINE}it... Ah, just take it literally!{SCROLL}The more Snowballs that hit the other{NEWLINE}Pokémon, the higher your score!{SCROLL}This is an event for powerful and{NEWLINE}skillful Pokémon... Ones just like me!{SCROLL}Do you understand what I mean?{SCROLL}OK, do you have any more questions?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 那么我就来说明一下「足球」！{SCROLL}就是把球打到对手的球门里,{SCROLL}只要是对手的球门{NEWLINE}随便哪里都是１点,{CLEAR}黄金球的话就是２点,{SCROLL}以团队的进球数决定名次,{SCROLL}按名次得分。{SCROLL}是像哥哥那样有力量有技术的{CLEAR}精灵所擅长的比赛！{SCROLL}明白了吗？{NEWLINE}那么,还有什么吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: I’ll explain “Goal Roll” for you.{SCROLL}Your Pokémon hit the ball into the other{NEWLINE}teams’ Goals.{SCROLL}Anywhere in another team’s Goal is{NEWLINE}worth one point, and a gold ball is{CLEAR}worth two.{SCROLL}The number of goals a team scores{NEWLINE}decides its rank,{SCROLL}and the rank decides the score.{SCROLL}This is an event for powerful and{NEWLINE}skillful Pokémon... Ones just like me!{SCROLL}Do you understand what I mean?{SCROLL}OK, do you have any more questions?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哇、哇哇哇！！{NEWLINE}是{VAR:0103:0}选手！{SCROLL}吧嗒吧嗒吧嗒吧嗒！{NEWLINE}摸到了！

strings.zh: 真意外,还有像我这样的{NEWLINE}欧巴桑啊！{CLEAR}我要不要也试着参加呢！{SCROLL}想接近崇拜的杰特选手！{CLEAR}开玩笑啦,啊哈哈！
strings.en: What a surprise, there are other old{NEWLINE}ladies like me here! Maybe I should give{CLEAR}it a try too!{SCROLL}I want to get close to my idol,{NEWLINE}Pokéathlete Jet! Just kidding, ahaha!

strings.zh: 呀啊！{VAR:0103:0}选手！{SCROLL}你若是出场的话{NEWLINE}女孩们的眼睛一定会发光的！{CLEAR}能不能得到签名啊⋯⋯{SCROLL}讨厌啦,{NEWLINE}不是我自己想要啦吼！
strings.en: Eek! Pokéathlete {VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}When you compete, the girls’ eyes are{NEWLINE}sure to light up!{SCROLL}Could I get an autograph...?{SCROLL}Oh, stop it! It’s not like I want it for{NEWLINE}myself!
